coffee_chats.summary: First coffee chat. Shivam is an AI Product Manager at Amazon. Wide-ranging conversation covering role targeting, story prep, networking cadence, portfolio depth, visa-aware company targeting, leveraging unique background, and interview strategy. Very encouraging — emphasized effort over outcome ("you'll find a job somewhere, but give your best").
coffee_chats.key_takeaways:
- Broaden role targeting beyond SCM: also pursue Product Management, Program Management, Vendor Management, and general Management roles.
- STAR stories: build an Excel sheet of all stories formatted in STAR method, categorized by behavioral theme (conflict management, prioritization, etc.).
- Networking tracker: build an Excel of everyone reached out to on LinkedIn — how they're beneficial, company culture, where they belong, what challenges the company faces.
- Networking cadence: ~2 coffee chats/week, plus 1 chat with a senior/partner. 1 mock interview every 2 weeks (2/month) to strengthen stories and learn current top interview questions.
- Start interview prep VERY early. Build portfolio VERY early.
- Portfolio depth matters as much as having projects: deeply understand how each project was made, how AI was used, and the real impact created.
- Top-20 H1B-sponsoring companies: make a list, tailor resume to each company's culture/values, and design portfolio around cultural values (e.g., Amazon = Leadership Principles; other companies have their own).
- Unique background is an asset: Microbiology → Uber (policy/risk management) → Supply Chain Management + AI. Companies like Google value unique backgrounds. NEED TO FIGURE OUT how to translate/portray this uniqueness as a strength (future brainstorm topic).
- Interview reality: apply to ~150 jobs → ~5 interviews → goal is to convert 4 of 5 through solid, well-scripted prep. Getting the interview is half the battle; converting it to an offer is the skill.
- Story clarity: stories should be so clear and transitional that the interviewer can easily take notes and later discuss with their team. Not complicated — clear, structured, impactful.
- Interviews dive progressively deeper. The interview industry is changing — stay current.
- Post-December eligibility: can apply for internships that start post-December. Chances low (~0.01) but worth trying. Look for both jobs AND internships joinable post-December.
- Work ethic: wake up early, leave late, work on one thing or another all day.
